contactLine: Hiring for AI engineering, or need an agent, skill or MCP server built?
aboutLead: I'm Beer, a Junior AI Engineer at ASAPCLOUD in the Netherlands.
about: I studied Creative Software Development at Grafisch Lyceum Utrecht and built games in Unity and C#. Enemy AI and ML-Agents pulled me toward AI. An internship in ASAPCLOUD's Data & AI team, building MCP servers in TypeScript, turned into the job I have now.
Today I build agents, agent skills and the tools around them, and I judge them by whether they finish real work, not by the demo. Outside work I scuba dive and make cocktails from scratch.
